name: session-meter
description: Shows a live session pane (/ctx): context breakdown, usage limits with pace, tool calls and model requests; sends the model a one-time note when limits or context cross a threshold, and can let the model compact or clear on its own

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at start
autoOpen.description: Open the session pane on its own when a session starts. Turn off to keep the screen clear; /ctx still opens it, and the notes to the model still go out.

contextAction.title: At the context threshold
contextAction.description: suggest: the model suggests /compact or a fresh session and you decide. compact: the model compacts at a natural break and continues. compact-or-clear: it may also clear, after writing a handoff that starts the new session.

contextAt.title: Context threshold (%)
contextAt.description: How full the context window gets before the model is told.
